description: This file defines a React context and hooks for managing user authentication state using Supabase. It includes context creation, provider component, and custom hooks for accessing auth data and actions.

classes.name: AuthContextValue
classes.description: Type defining the shape of the authentication context, including session info, user info, loading state, and auth methods.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to its children, managing session state and auth actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access the authentication context, throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Custom hook to derive user role from session's user metadata.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for compatibility.
